evidence.title: Nvidia partners with data center developer Cloverleaf
Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero

summary: Nvidia has teamed up with data center developer Cloverleaf to enhance AI infrastructure, highlighting the growing importance of scalable hardware solutions over model advancements. The collaboration aims to optimize data center designs for high-performance AI workloads.
title: Nvidia Partners with Cloverleaf to Advance AI Data Center Infrastructure
